name: Background work
usage: createQueue({ handlers: { "report.build": async (payload, { signal }) => … }, store: fileStore("data/jobs.json") }), call start(), and enqueue(type, payload) from a route instead of doing slow work in it. Failed attempts are retried (maxAttempts, backoffMs, timeoutMs); a job that fails every attempt is dead-lettered. Mount deadLetterRoutes(queue) behind the app's auth guard (SM-02) and origin guard (SM-03) to list, retry and discard dead letters. Never put a secret in a payload or in a handler's error message (both are stored, and errors are shown in the dead-letter list); handlers should honour their abort signal.
